title: cycas circinalis var. pectinata
intro: Cycas circinalis var. pectinata, commonly known as the palm cycad, is a species of cycad, a type of ancient coniferous plant. This plant has been found to offer several health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and prevent certain types of cancer due to its antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, Cycas circinalis var. pectinata has been used as a traditional medicine in various cultures, exhibiting anti-inflammatory and anti-hyperlipidemic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
